subject: Detection of outlier in RRBS dataset

messages.author: 24796d56ad196080
messages.subject: Detection of outlier in RRBS dataset
parts:
Hello everyone,
I have been working on a small RRBS dataset (20 samples). I would like to check if I have outliers. I used PCA plot and cluster dendogram. I think that I have two outliers but interpretation is highly subjective, when I remove them it seems that I have new ones.. and I was wondering if there are other ways to check for outliers.
Many thanks for your help
Best regards
Alice

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Detection of outlier in RRBS dataset
parts:
I would check clustering also conversion rates for all the samples, I would also control gender and age for the samples. If you have predefined groups you would expect to see some clustering for those groups 

Best
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Detection of outlier in RRBS dataset
parts:
Dear Altuna,
Many thanks for your reply. My group has same age (I mean adult and juvenile) and sex (Male). I don't think that I can check for conversion rate because I did not use a lambda phage as a control (Big mistake). I don't think there is a liable test to check for conversion other than using a reference. 
I will take a look into more details with the clustering approach. So far I used clusterSamples and PCASamples. 

Best
Alice
